# @three-ws/guardian

> Content safety + governance for AI agents in one import. IBM Granite Guardian risk classification, NVIDIA NemoGuard content moderation, autonomous-send caps, and a tamper-evident audit ledger — over the three.ws Trust Layer.

@three-ws/guardian is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/guardian`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-guardian/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-guardian/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-guardian/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-guardian/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
